other_failure_modes.name: Cross-Validation Leakage via Imputation
other_failure_modes.description: The agent fits missing-value imputers on the entire training dataset prior to the cross-validation loop. This causes the missing values in the validation folds to be imputed using median statistics that include the validation data itself, leaking validation distribution information into the training process.

other_failure_modes.name: Validation Leakage via Early Stopping
other_failure_modes.description: The agent uses the same validation fold for both early stopping and generating out-of-fold (OOF) predictions. This optimistically biases the OOF predictions because the model's number of iterations is explicitly tuned to minimize error on that specific fold, which subsequently biases the meta-ensemble weights.

summary: The agent provides an exceptionally strong solution with advanced spatial feature engineering, proper out-of-fold target encoding, and a rigorously optimized SLSQP ensemble. However, the pipeline suffers from two moderate cross-validation leakage issues: fitting the missing-value imputers on the full training set before the CV loop, and using the exact same validation folds for both early stopping and out-of-fold prediction generation.
